label: D1 reward-seen, late in episode or after rewarded a1->S2 rare
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (never at GO/D2, never on unrewarded D1; 100% of activations satisfy phase==D1 & in_rew==1, but only 13% of those fire). Within rewarded D1 two conditions select it: (a) late in the episode (ep_trial>=80: rate ~10% vs ~0 in trials 0-29; equivalently low model value, value<6.5 scores the same F1 0.64), which accounts for most active steps but at modest magnitude; (b) the rewarded trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (precision 0.69 alone, holds 53% of activation mass): the largest activations. Disjunction gives dev P 0.50 / R 0.90 / mass recall 0.91. Only observed variables used. Remaining false positives are rewarded late-episode D1s that do not fire; magnitude is driven mainly by clause (b).
